summary: The prepared source already gates network completion on asynchronous HiCache restoration. An issue-shaped L3-only 64-token fixture remained pending before prefetch completion, queued complete coverage afterward, and exposed transport success only when restore became ready. No production correction was justified; three regression cases were added.

tests.what_was_measured: Five TreeCore/HiCache tests passed, including the exact l1=0, l2=0, l3=64 pending and complete-prefetch boundaries plus transport-success gating.
Twenty-five focused tests passed across HiCache restore, decode transfer cleanup, and radix-cache lock ownership.
The patch contains no whitespace errors.

gpu_evidence: The assigned device was detected as one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. Issue-specific execution was CPU control-flow testing because the report requires a CP=8/DP=8 NVIDIA H20 Mooncake deployment and model/storage setup that were not supplied; raw/environment.txt records the device and runtime.
remaining_limitations: No eight-rank prefill CP plus eight-rank decode DP deployment was available.
The reported NVIDIA H20/CUDA environment differs from the assigned single AMD gfx950/ROCm device.
No model weights, persistent HiCache corpus, or restart-capable distributed serving fixture was supplied.
The regression validates restore ordering and index coverage, not Mooncake transport hardware, full-model semantic accuracy, or multi-node behavior.
